The test image shows the underside of a soybean leaf with:
- Small reddish-brown lesions scattered across the lower leaf surface
- Raised, white/cream pustules (uredinia) at the center of many lesions
- Distribution characteristic of lower leaf surface infection

The reference image confirms this matches Soybean rust — the upper-right panel shows the identical pattern of reddish-brown lesions with pustules on the lower leaf surface.
